Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect allow me to pay a cost of 2 even when I play a white Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less?
Can I also use this card's inherited effect to switch the attack target to an unsuspended [Eosmon]?

Effect: [When Digivolving] If it's your turn, you may play 1 white Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less or 1 level 5 or lower [Eosmon] from your hand for a play cost of 2. If this effect played, your opponent may play 1 Tamer card from their hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your [Eosmon].
